rho_reference.note: band shown for the 25-bit, T = 16384 cell (medians over 22 configurations); the admitted row is the T = 16384 cells, where IC4 is cheaper at every I/M and h. T = 4096 is unranked and T = 1024 dearer; strongest_available means the strongest rho in this harness, not ecbench's CORRECTION 2026-11-11 (research/mt_rho_start_fix_20261111): the rho arms had a restart defect that made the reference 1.4-4.8% too expensive (corrected IC4/rho at T = 16384: 0.95-0.99), and the family lacks Kuhn-Struik retention, against which IC4 is dearer at h = 0 (1.12-1.17x). strongest_available is therefore false and this row no longer passes the gate.
